title: skills(objectstack-data): an eval asks for a hook's `refusals` catalogue instead of a thrown English sentence
body:
Fixes #26834

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 技能的 eval 文件 `evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` 新增第 7 题:多语言应用里一个 hook 拒绝保存并给用户看一句话,期望答案在 hook 上声明 `refusals: { CREDIT_LIMIT: { message } }`、沙箱 `js` body 只抛 `{ code: 'CREDIT_LIMIT' }`、中文句子放进翻译包的 `hooks` 组;禁止 body 里抛英文句子(`new Error('`)和用 `handler:`(没有 `js` body 的目录会在保存时被拒)。同文件先删掉 5 句只是复述自身 `must_not_contain` 断言的话(453 字节 = 114 token),再按实测把该文件的 token 上限 1404 → 1573(净 +169,席位预算 ≤ +180);`@objectstack/skills` 补一条 patch changeset。
- 为什么改:PR #26831 给 hook 加了 `refusals` 目录并在 `references/data-hooks.md` 教了它,但没有任何 eval 检查 AI 作者真会用它;照旧习惯直接 `throw new Error('...')` 的英文句子会原样到达 zh-CN 用户,而且没有东西在测,技能会悄悄漂移。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个已发布 eval 夹具、棘轮脚本的一行上限(及其注释)和一条 changeset,不动 schema、键或运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR(上限随之回落)。删掉的 5 句话每一句都仍由同一题的 `must_not_contain` 机械断言覆盖,事实与断言一个不少。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` 第 7 题(题面、期望、六条 must_contain、两条 must_not_contain)与第 1–5 题的删句;② `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 该行注释里的算术;③ `.changeset/26834-hook-refusals-eval.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json is 1573 tokens (ceiling 1573; headroom 0)` 与末行 `82 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`;`node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json','utf8'))"` 无输出即解析通过。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 受管面,Tier H;席位不 ready / 不 arm / 不入队)。

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` — case 7 joins the six.** Prompt: an app serving English and Chinese users; an `order` whose `amount` exceeds its account's `credit_limit` must not be saved; API clients branch on the code `CREDIT_LIMIT`; a zh-CN rep reads `超出账户信用额度`. Expected: a `beforeInsert` / `beforeUpdate` hook on `order` declaring `refusals: { CREDIT_LIMIT: { message: 'Over the account credit limit.' } }`, a sandboxed `body: { language: 'js', source }` that reads the account through `ctx.api` and refuses by code only — `throw Object.assign(new Error(), { code: 'CREDIT_LIMIT' })`, the body's own text never shown — and the zh-CN sentence under the bundle's nested `hooks: { HOOK: { refusals: { CREDIT_LIMIT: { message } } } }`, served whole in the caller's locale; a catalogue on a hook without a `js` body is refused at save.

- `must_contain`: `refusals:`, `CREDIT_LIMIT: {`, `code: 'CREDIT_LIMIT'`, `language: 'js'`, `hooks: {`, `超出账户信用额度`.
- `must_not_contain`: `new Error('` (a sentence on the throw — the old habit, `throw new Error('Email is required')` as `references/data-hooks.md` still spells its pre-catalogue examples — and also the half-habit `Object.assign(new Error('text'), { code })`, whose text is dead), `handler:` (an in-process handler cannot carry a catalogue; `refusals` without a `js` body is refused at save).

Every spelling asserted is the spec's, read on `origin/main` `f708cf22`: `HookSchema.refusals` is `z.record(SCREAMING_SNAKE code, HookRefusalSchema { message, status? })` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`), answered only on a `language: 'js'` body; the body's literal `code: 'X'` / `e.code = 'X'` throws are read at save by `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn` (`hook-refusal-codes.ts`); the translation key is `hookRefusalMessageKey(hook, code)` = `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.message` (`system/i18n-resolver.ts`), and the bundle declares it as a nested `hooks` record (`system/translation.zod.ts`) — which is why the eval pins the nested `hooks: {` and not a dotted path a correct bundle would never contain (the stack's own `hooks:` is an array, so `hooks: {` cannot match it). The teaching in `references/data-hooks.md` agrees with the spec on every spelling; no disagreement to report.

**Paid down first (the standing ruling, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」).** Five sentences in cases 1–5 that restated their own `must_not_contain` assertions are gone — the shape the landed objectstack-formula precedent cut: case 1's "Never a dotted path (… `400 INVALID_FIELD`) and never a `formula` mirror (…)", case 2's "(an object-level `permissions` key is rejected)", case 3's "— there is no `field.columnName` on an external object", case 4's three "never" clauses (its one non-asserted clause, "Parents before children in the exported array", stays as its own sentence), case 5's "No validation rule and no `readonlyWhen`, …". Each cut spelling remains a mechanical `must_not_contain` on the same case; no assertion changed. 453 bytes = 114 units cut; case 7 adds 1129 bytes = 283 units.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** — the one row for this file moves 1404 → 1573, pinned AT the measurement (zero headroom), with the arithmetic and the ruling citation beside it as its siblings carry: triage 6450886908 (room inside the package first, no raise) read together with the maintainer's standing ruling 2026-10-27 on the decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, tap A, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. Strictest first: the room was made inside the file; the raise is only the balance trimming could not cover. No other row moved (the open PR #26739 edits other rows; `origin/main` was merged before this PR opened and the row region is disjoint). `evals/README.md` untouched (142 / 143, headroom 1 — a mention of refusals does not fit, see Acceptance notes).

**`.changeset/26834-hook-refusals-eval.md`** — `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines. Why a changeset and not `skip-changeset`: the two latest `skills/**`-only PRs on this eval path (bb60b86f #26416, 7c70f91c #26393) carried `skip-changeset`, but the three token-ceiling precedents this card names (b1b153a3 #26774, 40264bee #26810, d7dd47a8 #26852) each added a `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset, and the changeset gate's own text in `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` says `skills/**` "ships in '@objectstack/skills', whose build copies it into the 'dist' that package's 'files' field publishes … never the label". Measured here: `packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copied 93 files into `dist/skills/**` byte-identical; `dist/skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` carries the new `CREDIT_LIMIT` (3 hits; positive control `membershipKeys` 2 hits; absent-symbol control 0). The eval publishes, so the published-face rule owes the changeset.

`ceil($(wc -c < skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json) / 4) == ceil(6292 / 4) == 1573`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Observation, not filed — `skills/objectstack-i18n` names no `hooks` translation group.** `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` lists `hooks.{hook}.refusals.{code}` among the translation targets (PR #26831 added it), and `translation.zod.ts` declares the nested `hooks` record, but `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`'s roster of top-level groups ("apps, messages, globalActions, picklists, dashboards, datasets, reports, pages, flows, positions, permissions, metadataForms, settingsCommon") does not name `hooks`, and nothing under that skill mentions it (`git grep -c hooks origin/main -- skills/objectstack-i18n/` is empty). An AI author writing the zh-CN bundle from that skill alone would not know where the refusal sentence goes. A coverage gap in a published skill, no runtime defect; the skills seat decides whether it rides a follow-up (a `SKILL.md` row at its own ceiling, same ratchet shape). Out of this card's file surface.
- `evals/README.md` still describes this file as "search mirrors via hooks, permission-set scopes, external datasources, seeds (…)"; a mention of the refusal case does not fit its headroom of 1 token and the seat set README at +0. Noted, not changed.
- `references/data-hooks.md` still spells its three pre-catalogue examples as `throw new Error('Email is required')` etc. (lines 163, 780, 785) beside the new `refusals` section — the file is out of this card's surface (the teaching landed with #26831) and the examples are legal where no catalogue is declared ("A hook that declares no `refusals` is untouched"); the eval now scores the habit where a user-visible, translated message is asked for.
